author_or_account: M. Jamil, Ph.D.; Connected Learning Lab
title: How Teens Use and View AI
discussion_signal: The relay describes teen AI use as mostly instrumental—information, schoolwork, and fun—while also noting emerging emotional-support use, concern about overreliance, and a gap between perceived personal benefit and broader social concern.
linked_research_question: When teens use AI for both practical help and emotional support, where do instrumental convenience and emerging relational dependence begin to diverge?
limits: The post compresses survey results into a short summary
Reported use is not evidence of benefit or harm
